Colorfigures: the toaster

Push the lever, change the shade, turn the object, then enable See-through and Labels to examine the mechanism. This is the package's original toaster example, built with its own Python exporter.

Our type,
from scratch.

Ten related original display prototypes, built from authored geometry and distributed under OFL 1.1. Compare them with the same text.

Make something worth keeping.

ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ
abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz 0123456789

Prototype status: one Regular style per font, 95 printable ASCII characters, shared original skeleton. No kerning, accents or complex-script shaping. Missing characters fall back to Arial. These are not yet full production text families. Font files carry the SIL Open Font License.

Original font source

Original font workflow

The reusable ui-font-prototype skill authors new glyph geometry. It includes a fresh-output TTF builder, an outline preview and a structural checker. Its rounded and angular variants share one original skeleton.

TTF generation and structural checks require already installed FontTools. The original generated demonstration is omitted because its font distribution terms were not selected. The licensed type specimen uses the separate OFL prototypes; it is not presented as output of this skill.

Portable diagram source

JSON Canvas

Editable, portable boards for relationships, flows and notes. The JSON Canvas skill preserves existing node IDs and links rather than flattening a board into an image.

Idea→Evidence→Decision

Download the actual editable .canvas board. The diagram previews its three nodes; this is not an embedded Canvas editor. Bounded adaptation of MIT-licensed Obsidian skill guidance.
